message: Merge keys are not unique in right dataset; not a one-to-one merge
cause: The 30 historical rows correctly have no anonymous code; the join mistakenly included their repeated empty code.
fix: Filter to the 90 nonempty unique anonymous codes before the common30 join; no classification, denominator or rule change.
regression_test: A one-code table joins a table containing repeated empty historical codes only after filtering empty codes.
